items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: Armstrong came in and heard him.

ctx.x: I knew his brother, but I never met him in time. Blackie, I knew him.

Yeah, but this boy was a handsome boy. He could pass the Spanish. He played with us a lot, but then he started to pull up that dope and that was it. He died young, but I don't remember him when he was four years old and playing piano. He couldn't even reach the pedals. He was a little bit of a piano player. They tried to make something out of him. Armstrong came in and heard him. A few of those big bands heard him and all. I don't want to learn how to read. But boy, he had a style. He'd make that piano rock. He…
Well I must know somebody from that neighborhood.
